Smart Filters are saved-searches for the Conversations view that automatically group and sort messages based on criteria (assignee, status, tags, last reply time, custom fields, etc.), so users don’t have to manually scan their inbox. rounds.response:
- Smart Filters — per-user, persistent saved views on the Conversations list that auto-update server-side; use when someone needs a reusable inbox view for ongoing monitoring (they don’t modify conversation data).  
- Quick search/filters — ad‑hoc, temporary queries applied via the search bar or filter controls; use for one‑off lookups or troubleshooting (these aren’t saved).  
- Tags — labels attached to conversations that act as attributes you can filter or report on; use for classification, routing, and cross‑team coordination.  
- Bulk actions — one‑time changes (close, assign, add/remove tags, etc.) applied to selected conversations; they change data and are not persistent views.  
Rule of thumb: recommend Smart Filters for recurring monitoring, quick filters/search for ad‑hoc checks, tags for categorization/workflow, and bulk actions when you need to change many conversations at once.
